_source: Chain.vb (and Form1.vb for the [ ] mace range and the live-tuning keys). Screen units, per frame. The F key's followMouse is UNI-T47. maceSize and maceRect are rectMace's: Left link.X + maceRect.x, Top link.Y + maceSize / 2, Right link.X + maceSize, Bottom link.Y - maceSize / 2 + maceRect.y (renderChain, with the mace's maceOffset already added).

tuning._source: Form1.vb's live-tuning keys (UNI-T51): Insert/Delete changeResistance(+/-0.001), Home/End changeGravity(-/+0.00001) on gravity's y, PageUp/PageDown changeSpring(+/-0.001). Same units as the figures above (the HUD's Res/Grav/Spring readout).
tuning._limits: Not in the original, which just added (BIBLE V19): resistance 0..1 (no negative drag, never more than a frame's speed), gravity's y -0.01 (4x the pull) .. 0.0025 (the pull reversed), spring 0.001 (one step above none) .. 0.25 (2.5x, under the stiffness the fixed step stays stable at with the overhead boost). A reset puts the figures above back.

skins._source: Textures.vb loads gfx/chain's link, aqua, emerald, teardrop, tablet and pearl at 16 x 16 (magenta colour-keyed); Chain.vb's loadChain gives every link texChain (link); Form1.vb's U sets link(1) to link(5) to texAqua, texEmerald, texTeardrop, texTablet and texPearl (UNI-T41). Nothing sets them back: no reset touches them and a second U changes nothing. The mace's link stays the mace whatever its index (BIBLE V25).

keyU._about: Link index to the skin U puts on it.

files._about: Every link picture of gfx/chain, by name, as Assets/Unity.Rea.Chain/Art/Chain holds it (lowercased .png, the magenta baked to alpha).

maceSkins._source: Chain.vb declares theMaceMode (SpikeBall, Magnet) and maceMode = SpikeBall, but nothing reads or sets it; Textures.vb loads gfx/chain/mace's mace (texMace) and mace2 (texMaceGrapple) at 32 x 32, and magnet.PNG only ships with the project (Chain.vbproj), so the magnet could never be seen (BIBLE D4). The port makes it a skin (UNI-T43): mode is the one every mace starts in, the Player map's ToggleMaceMode (M, a debug key the original lacks) steps to the next; no reset touches it, and the hit, catch and throw are the same whatever the mace wears. Input.vb's left-mouse-down/up also swaps link(Mace).texture to texMaceGrapple while the grapple is armed, over whichever mode is current, reverting to that mode's picture on release (U.CHN-T72).

files._about: Each mode's picture, as Assets/Unity.Rea.Chain/Art/Chain holds it (lowercased .png). grapple is not a mode: it is shown over whichever mode is current while the grapple is armed (Input.vb's texMaceGrapple).

port._about: Not in the original; world units and seconds, never mapped. keepInArena, pullBothNeighbors, simulateAllLinks and maceDamageFormula are settled deviations (U.CHN-T45, and keepInArena U.CHN-T76: false, as checkBounds is commented out in Chain.vb, BIBLE V4; true bounces links off the arena at wallBounce): false/false/true/Original reproduce Chain.vb's own behaviour (its If/ElseIf only ever pulls the previous link, BIBLE D7; animateChain always loops every link, BIBLE V3/D8; checkMaceImpact's abs(dX + dY/2) of the mass-divided velocity, BIBLE D11); true/false/SpeedTimesFactor are the rebuild's earlier choices, kept only where this file asks for them explicitly. chainLine false (the default, U.CHN-T94) draws link.png on each link's linkSize quad as renderChain does; true is the port's earlier tiled line through the links, a data option only. hitShape Rectangle (the default, U.CHN-T88) tests rectMace against Enemy.vb's rectangle with Root.vb's rectIntersect (only the mace's edges inside the enemy's), sweeping the rectangle along each step's move so a fast swing cannot tunnel (BIBLE D12); Circle is the port's earlier swept circle of hitRadius, a data option only.
